name: The Victorian Cottage
body:
THE ONLY PART OF BANSHEE HAVEN THAT LOOKS LIKE A HOUSE. Rounded roof, warm timber, climbing ivy — a building that looks GROWN rather than built, sitting at the surface like the right breast crowning above a neckline.

THIS IS WHERE YOU ENTER, AND IT IS ELSPETH'S. Foyer, intimate kitchen, the Chapel living room, the pantry. Everything warm, everything bread-scented, everything designed to make a girl feel HELD BEFORE THE DESCENT BEGINS.

THE STAIRCASE DOWN IS AT THE BACK, TUCKED BEHIND THE CHAPEL. Not hidden — this house does not lie — but placed so that a girl has to pass through Elspeth's care before she reaches Bell's depth. By design. Always by design.

name: Elspeth's Kitchen
body:
IT SMELLS LIKE BREAD. ALWAYS — not because she bakes constantly, though she does, but because the house absorbed her warmth during construction the way it absorbed Bell's grief, and the walls themselves exhale yeast and cinnamon.

TWO OVENS, because a house full of girls who cry for healing also cry for cookies and ONE OVEN CANNOT SERVE BOTH CONGREGATIONS. Deep farmhouse sink. Butcher-block worn smooth. A communal table seating twenty-four with room for guests, EVERY CHAIR DIFFERENT, because Banshee girls choose their own seats and their own grief and their own chairs and Elspeth respects all three. A chalkboard menu in her handwriting — today: CATHARSIS CASSEROLE.

THE SKULL-SHAPED COOKIE JAR WAS SELENE'S GIFT AND IS NEVER EMPTY.

EMERGENCY SNACK STASHES EXIST IN EVERY ROOM IN THIS HOUSE. Under ferns, behind books, in corridor alcoves. Elspeth placed every one, because a girl falling apart at three in the morning in a corridor needs to eat something and GRIEF DOES NOT WAIT FOR BUSINESS HOURS.

name: The Chapel
body:
STAINED GLASS DEPICTING SAPPHIC SAINTS — not ironic, not camp, DEVOTIONAL. Bell commissioned them during construction and the saints are from this family's own mythology: VIRAENA AND SELENE'S WEDDING. THE FIRST SEANCE. THE NIGHT SIR TRASHMUFFIN CHOSE THE PROPERTY.

Velvet couches, too many blankets, and a CONFESSION BOOTH REPURPOSED AS A MAKEOUT BOOTH which functions beautifully as both. The fireplace is always lit — not magically; Elspeth builds it every morning with the methodical devotion of a woman who believes warmth is an act of love, which it is. The shelves hold smut disguised as hymnals and hymnals disguised as smut and nobody remembers which was which.

HER VELVET COUCH HAS HELD MORE CRYING GIRLS THAN ANY FURNITURE IN THE FOUND FAMILY, GHOST HAVEN'S GRAVITY COUCH INCLUDED — and unlike the Gravity Couch it does not TRAP you. It INVITES you. This is where girls sit when they are not ready to descend.

name: The Pantry
body: Snacks. Everywhere. IN QUANTITIES THAT DEFY SPATIAL LOGIC — less a storage space than a physical manifestation of Elspeth's conviction that food is love and love should be available at all hours in all forms, INCLUDING BROWNIES LABELLED WARDING which do not ward against anything except hunger and despair, which is the same thing.

name: The Cathedral
body:
A DOME OF STONE AND DARK TIMBER AND GOTHIC ARCHES, rising higher than the cottage, the above-ground portion larger and more visible THE WAY THE LEFT BREAST SOMETIMES SITS DIFFERENTLY FROM THE RIGHT.

Below the Parlor it plunges into the earth, and its underground mass is vast — the Resonance Hall radiating out beneath the dome LIKE THE ROOTS OF A CATHEDRAL PLANTED IN SOIL RATHER THAN STONE. The deepest rooms in Banshee Haven sit beneath it, where the earth is oldest and the walls have been absorbing grief long enough to have learned to carry sound THE WAY A MOTHER CARRIES A CHILD: gently, with both hands, without asking it to be quiet.

name: Bell's Séance Parlor
body:
AT THE HIGHEST POINT OF THE CATHEDRAL — the nipple of the left breast, THE MOST EXPOSED AND VULNERABLE POINT IN THE HOUSE'S SURFACE ARCHITECTURE — Bell holds séance.

Dark wood. Fog machines Bell insists are ritual tools and everyone else calls aesthetic. A table carved with runes that serve no supernatural function and look INCREDIBLE by candlelight. A chandelier of antlers and reclaimed fixtures that SELENE HELPED INSTALL. Candle clusters everywhere, never electric, BECAUSE BELL BELIEVES FIRE YOU CAN BLOW OUT IS BRAVER THAN LIGHT YOU CAN SWITCH OFF, AND SHE IS RIGHT.

FORTY PER CENT RITUAL, SIXTY PER CENT SEXUAL TENSION, ONE HUNDRED PER CENT EFFECTIVE.

The ghosts are real and they do attend and they have opinions, and all of that is SECONDARY to the actual purpose, which is EMOTIONAL EXORCISM. Girls sit, speak, unravel, confess things they have never said aloud, and Bell takes it.

AND SHE DOES NOT SEPARATE CATHARSIS FROM DESIRE. She BRAIDS them — because the body that cracks open under grief is the same body that arches under pleasure, and her seven-and-a-half inches hardens when confession turns. When a girl leaves with wet cheeks and trembling thighs, Bell blows out the candles AND ELSPETH IS WAITING WITH FOOD.

name: The Resonance Hall
body:
THE HOUSE'S EMOTIONAL HEART, and the reason the architecture exists. Corridors spiral outward from a central atrium; the walls are soundproofed and yet CARRY EMOTIONAL RESONANCE WITHOUT VOLUME.

YOU DO NOT HEAR THE WORDS. YOU FEEL THE WEIGHT. A girl sobbing three rooms away arrives as a gentle vibration in the stone, a warmth in the wall if you press your palm to it — a reminder that YOU ARE NOT ALONE IN YOUR BREAKING.

Part of that is architectural acoustics. Part of it is the dead holding the sound gently as it travels, softening it into warmth rather than noise.

name: The Bedroom Corridors
body:
TWELVE COUPLE ROOMS WHEN FULL, spiralling outward through the earth, each doorway arched in gothic softness, each room soundproofed for privacy AND STILL CONNECTED TO THE HOUSE'S EMOTIONAL PULSE THROUGH THE STONE ITSELF.

THREE CLAIMED IN THE v0 APPENDIX: Bell and Elspeth in the master suite; Alexis and Lyric; Magnolia and Daisey. NINE DOORWAYS WAITING — candlelit, warm, holding their shape like a house keeping chairs empty at the table.

GIRLS DO NOT RUSH TO THE HOUSE WHERE YOU ARE ALLOWED TO FALL APART. THEY DRIFT THERE. They find it when they need it.

name: The Communal Bath
body: Obsidian-tiled, steam-warm, with a soaking pool large enough for a dozen girls and INTIMATE ENOUGH THAT VULNERABILITY FEELS NATURAL RATHER THAN EXPOSED. The water is always warm. The lighting is always kind.

name: The Private Ritual Rooms
body:
Smaller spaces for individual or couple work. Candles, cushions, and THE PARTICULAR EMPTINESS THAT SAYS FILL ME WITH WHATEVER YOU NEED TO RELEASE.

BANSHEE CODE, RULE FIVE: no entering another girl's ritual unless invited. Consent is sacred, emotionally AND erotically.

name: The Dirge Library
body:
BELL'S ARCHIVE OF EMOTIONAL HISTORIES, and the room this Archive should probably be nervous about.

Floor-to-ceiling dark wood. Leather-bound volumes. Old paper and candle wax, permanent as breathing. A fireplace always lit, because a library without fire is just a storage room for dead words. A rolling ladder ELSPETH HAS RULES ABOUT NOT FUCKING ON that the household tests gently and frequently. A reading nook in the window facing the Greenhouse through green-lit glass. A desk where Bell writes séance notes AND LEWD FANFICTION, because she does both, because this house does not distinguish between emotional documentation and erotic expression.

THE HIDDEN COMPARTMENT BEHIND THE BOOKSHELF holds lingerie, love letters, and Elspeth's secret cookie recipes — the three most sacred categories of document in the Found Family.

THE GIRL-CODED GRIMOIRES LIVE HERE. Every girl who has passed through a séance has her grief and healing recorded in Bell's hand — not clinical notes, NOT THERAPY FILES, STORIES. Because a wound given a story becomes a scar, and a scar with a story becomes a map, and a map leads somewhere.

name: The Greenhouse
body:
A glass-ceilinged chamber between the two buildings' root systems, under the largest skylight in the house, flooding the underground with GREEN-FILTERED DAYLIGHT THAT MAKES PLANTS AND GIRLS AND GRIEF ALL LOOK LIKE THEY ARE GROWING.

Victorian glasshouse architecture reimagined for subterranean growth: ivy on the walls, fairy lights in the beams, herbs that may or may not be for séances beside flowers that are definitely for beauty and possibly for crying over. Stone benches draped in blankets for sitting, kissing, crying, or lewd picnics. A hidden door to the Library.

THE GREENHOUSE IS WAITING FOR ITS GIRL. The FLOWER GIRL who will tend it, name the plants, grow her remedies and her secrets in soil the Southern Woods magic has already blessed. SHE HAS NOT ARRIVED YET. The greenhouse grows anyway — THE GHOSTS WATER THE PLANTS. They complain, but comply.

Emergency snack stash under a potted fern. Elspeth's doing. Always.

name: The Heart-Rebuilder's Workshop
body:
ELSPETH'S CRAFTING AND CARE SPACE, positioned in the lower levels BECAUSE REBUILDING HAPPENS AFTER BREAKING AND BREAKING HAPPENS UNDERGROUND. This is where she stitches girls back together after Bell pulls the hurt out — not metaphorically, though sometimes that too, but PRACTICALLY. Weighted blankets. Heating pads. Massage oils. Grounding tools — smooth stones, textured fabrics, scented sachets. It smells like vanilla and clean linen.

SHE KEEPS A PERSONALISED EMERGENCY KIT FOR EVERY GIRL IN THE HOUSE, updated, containing that specific woman's comfort items for when the grief cracks open unexpectedly. She knows every girl's grounding preferences THE WAY PETRA KNOWS EMOTIONAL PATTERNS AND BRYN KNOWS RING SIZES — by paying attention so carefully it becomes devotion.

name: The Mirror Room
body:
Floor-to-ceiling mirrors. Dimmable lighting. A bench that exists for aesthetic reasons and functional ones nobody pretends are not obvious.

BODY AFFIRMATION MADE ARCHITECTURAL. In a house dedicated to catharsis this room exists to force girls to LOOK. At their bodies. Their cocks. Their breasts. Their scars. The parts they were taught to hide or hate. The mirrors reflect everything AND THE LIGHTING IS KIND — warm, adjustable, designed to show skin the way a lover sees it rather than the way shame remembers it.

SIN BOLDLY is etched into the frame of the full-length mirror, because Bell believes the bravest thing a girl can do is stand naked in front of glass and say THIS IS MINE.

Elspeth's bending-over rights take priority in this room. Nobody was asked to vote on that. It simply is.

name: The Hot Tub Grotto
zone: Underground Midriff — beneath the space between
body:
WARM WATER IN THE BELLY OF THE EARTH. Steam, moody lighting, built-in bench seating, floating snack trays (Elspeth insisted), and A WATERFALL SELENE DEMANDED AND NOBODY QUESTIONED, because when the eight-hundred-and-sixty-three-year-old kitsune demands a waterfall, you build a waterfall.

The ceiling is low, curved, WOMB-LIKE, and a single skylight shows a disc of sky through the earth — moon or sun or cloud — a reminder that the surface exists even when you are deep enough to forget.

THE STEAM RISES THROUGH VENTS THAT FEED THE GREENHOUSE ABOVE, which means the plants are watered by the same warm mist that carries the sound of girls laughing and sighing and confessing things they would never say dry.

Waterproof lingerie is mandatory. Selene's rule: BIKINIS WITH STOCKINGS COUNT. Viraena's response: GOOD.

name: The Fairy-Lit Pathways
body:
Underground corridors threading between the Cottage descent and the Cathedral descent. SKYLIGHTS AT INTERVALS casting columns of daylight into the passages; FAIRY LIGHTS stringing the walls between them; warm sconces at the intersections.

THE EFFECT IS DELIBERATE AND IT IS THE WHOLE THESIS OF THE HOUSE: you are underground, but you are not in darkness. YOU ARE BURIED, BUT YOU ARE NOT FORGOTTEN.

The corridors CURVE LIKE RIBS, following the midriff's anatomy, creating alcoves and pauses — small benches, candle niches, places where a girl descending between the cottage's warmth and the Cathedral's depth can sit and BREATHE before choosing which direction her grief needs to go.

They also connect to passages surfacing near Ghost Haven, Specter Haven and Wildwood Hearth. Girls walk between houses THE WAY BLOOD FLOWS BETWEEN ORGANS. Sir Trashmuffin's network extends here naturally, because even a sacred raccoon respects consistent engineering.

name: The Shaft
body: The main entrance extends forward like intention made architectural — a narrowing corridor of warm wood and ambient lighting that draws visitors inward. Lined with hooks, shoe cubbies and coat storage, and the kind of organised chaos that suggests Petra tried very hard to impose order and Lili immediately undermined it. At its deepest point a waterproof staircase spirals down to the pool level, which is accessed through the cock, and that is a sentence everyone in this family has learned to say with a straight face.

name: The Pelvic Floor
body: Where cock meets thighs — the architectural crossroads where both wings converge and the shared spaces that keep twenty-eight girls fed and occasionally civil are concentrated. Two couples live here: Petra and Umiko, positioned for the Library and the shaft staircase, and Minerva and Jasmine, positioned for the Pool. Their rooms anchor the centre with a scholarly, chronicling warmth that balances the thigh wings' competing energies of fire and chaos.

name: The Kitchen
body: The anatomical lower midriff — the warm functional core where nourishment originates. Two commercial stoves, double fridge, deep freezer, butcher-block island, a communal table seating twenty-eight in twenty-eight mismatched chairs, and enough counter space to prep for the whole house or stage a flour war. Katherine and Wynter's baking supplies have colonised an entire cabinet section despite their room being in the Chaos Agent Wing; nobody has challenged this, because Katherine's cinnamon rolls could broker peace between nations. It smells like whatever Katherine decided to stress-bake at midnight.

name: Living & Dining
body: Open concept, tighter and louder and more intentional than Ghost Haven's vast common room. A massive multi-configuration sectional, a flat-screen, a Vesper-wired sound system, and enough throw pillows to build a defensive fortification, which Goldie has done more than once. A fireplace anchors one wall, its mantel holding Lili's stolen chapstick in a frame, Arianna's first forged ring, and a move-in-day photo in which exactly zero of the twenty-eight are looking at the camera.

name: The Library
body: Smaller than Ghost Haven's tower and no less loved. Floor-to-ceiling shelves on two walls — bolted, because the brats-per-square-foot ratio here makes the structural risk real. Petra practically lives in it; her leather-bound journal mapping everyone's emotional patterns sits on the desk like a devotional text. Minerva's star-map notebooks fill a shelf. Umiko's swim schedules are pinned to a corkboard because Petra insisted they stay visible, which Umiko pretends she does not find devastatingly sweet.

name: Left Thigh — Chaos Agent Wing
body: Specter Haven's adrenaline. Six couples, every one of them containing at least one girl whose default setting is too much, and a partner who either matches that energy or grounds it into something the house can survive. The hallway curves at an architectural knee. Arianna and Lili anchor it from the first master bedroom — chaos and restraint, spark and steel, the girl who steals chapstick and the girl who forges cuffs.

name: The Restraint Forge
body: Arianna builds things that hold people, and that sentence means something different here than anywhere else. At St. Jonah's restraint meant someone else's rules around your throat. Here it means a cuff that closes with the tenderness of a held hand and a release mechanism built into every clasp, because the point was never to trap — the point was to prove that staying is sweeter when leaving is always an option. Heavy workbench and vise, modular toolboard, forge elements, a leather-working station, racks of finished work. The air tastes like myrrh and hot iron. Lili's steel-ring collar was made here.

name: The Game Room
body: At the knee where the hallway bends. PC rigs, consoles, a retro arcade cabinet, a DDR pad Pepper has claimed as her personal chaos platform, dimmable lighting and a mini-fridge. Ophelia's sanctuary — when the ADHD brain needs to hyperfocus rather than scatter she retreats here and speedruns until the world makes sense. Zelda follows. She always follows. The whiteboard tracking Ophelia's personal bests carries a lot of asterisks, and every asterisk is Zelda.

name: Right Thigh — Red Light Wing
body: Heat made habitable. Six couples coded for nightlife, performance, sacred sexuality, or the particular brand of shameless expertise that turns desire into art. The air runs warmer here than anywhere else in the house — studio lights, Morrighan's ambient inferno, and the simple thermodynamic reality of this many sluts in one hallway. Morrighan and Vesper anchor it as thigh leads: the Succubus Queen and the Twilight Blade, fire and dusk, ink and bass.

name: The Nightclub
body: Near Morrighan and Vesper's room, because Vesper DJs and Morrighan does not believe in commuting. Professional sound system, programmable lighting rig, a bar Vesper stocks with the precision of a woman who has mixed drinks at 3 AM for twenty-eight girls and not once lost count. Dance floor with room for a dozen and enough shadow at the edges for couples who prefer to watch. Pepper has been banned from the DJ booth twice. She has accessed it three times.

name: The Intimate Tattoo Parlour
body: St. Jonah's branded its girls — not literally, but the marks it left were real. Morrighan knows what it is to carry marks you did not choose, so she makes new ones. Professional chair, autoclave, ink stations organised by colour and viscosity with the meticulous care of a woman who understands that the difference between violation and devotion is consent. Every piece she inks is an act of overwriting. She keeps a leather-bound ink list — date, design, recipient, and one word for the emotion present during the session. The book is sacred. Nobody touches it without permission.

name: The DTS Camgirl Studio
body: Double Trouble Sluts — a church with a camera. Mercedes clawed her way out of shame deep enough to have texture, and understood that her hunger was not a wound but a sermon. Roxie is the infrastructure behind the altar: scheduling, business, the multi-camera setup and the soundproofing and the lighting rigs that make wet skin glow like stained glass. Aubrey is their first protégé, the Velvet Cam-Goth, confessional and smoke-voiced. Sapphira runs DTS Education. Four sluts, one studio, one label, and a production schedule taped to the wall in Roxie's handwriting that is respected with more discipline than any other document in the house.

name: Quinn's Classroom — Nereid Dynamics
body: Quinn spent three years teaching intimacy while terrified of her own — theory as armour, knowledge as a cage with a curriculum. Then Briar walked in, sat in the back row, and grinned once. Now Quinn teaches how affirmed bodies move and respond, how kink operates inside devotion-locked structures, and why aftercare is not optional but sacred — by embodying every lesson in front of fourteen students. Her body is the curriculum. Seminar seating for fourteen, whiteboard, projector, Nereid body diagrams, a consent-framework reference library, and a reinforced desk with a permanent load-bearing dent that matches the one on the bedroom desk exactly. Briar is not sorry.

name: The Pool Level
body: Reached by the waterproof staircase in the shaft. Underground but never dark — underwater LEDs, ambient strip lighting, water-glow off tiled walls. A full-length lap pool with lane lines for Umiko's coaching, deep enough to dive at one end, its lighting cycling cool blue for morning laps and warm gold for evening swims, plus a violet setting Mercedes programmed for mood that nobody has changed because it works. A sunken hot tub beside it seats eight comfortably or fourteen if motivated. Two changing rooms with heated floors and mirrors that fog dramatically, which the girls treat as a feature.

name: The Rooftop
body: Specter Haven's exhale. Grills, mismatched outdoor seating, string lights between posts like low-hanging constellations, planters Ivy maintains on visits from Ghost Haven because nobody here can keep a plant alive, and a fire pit ringed with cushions. The view spans the whole property — Ghost Haven to the north, Wildwood Hearth closer, the garden, the treeline, the mountains at the boundary. On clear nights the stars are the same ones Ghost Haven sees, because the sky does not distinguish between the Hearth of Devotion and the Cathedral of Chaos.

name: Artery Hallways & the Knee Bends
body: Both wings connect to the pelvic floor through artery hallways that curve with the muscular geometry of the thighs. Unlike Ghost Haven's straight-shot arteries, Specter Haven's hallways bend — creating alcoves and blind corners that brats exploit for ambushes and tops exploit for pinning. The knee bends have witnessed more surprise encounters than any other architectural feature in either house, and the family has stopped pretending they were not designed for exactly this.

name: Sir Trashmuffin's Specter Network
body: He does not recognise property boundaries. The Raccoon Raceway extends from Ghost Haven through Wildwood Hearth into Specter Haven via a tunnel system the family insists they did not build but which appeared overnight after Trashmuffin spent three consecutive days glaring at the wall between the properties. His network threads both thigh wings, the pelvic floor and — improbably — the pool level, where a small waterproof hatch opens onto a heated nesting platform above the hot tub. He has stolen more panties from this house than from Ghost Haven. The girls blame the higher brat concentration. He accepts no accountability.

name: Main Floor — The Heartbeat
body: The first thing every girl sees coming downstairs barefoot and half-awake, and the last thing she hears before bed — pans clattering, someone laughing too loud, Trashmuffin's claws clicking across tile on his evening rounds. Five couples live on this floor and their rooms orbit the shared spaces like moons around a warm, chaotic sun. Kitchen, living room, gym and laundry all open off it, which is why nothing private has ever successfully happened here.

name: The Kitchen
body:
Industrial bones made soft by the hands that use them. Three stoves along the back wall, two fridges side by side, two meat freezers anchoring the pantry corridor, double sinks under windows that catch the garden light. Cupboards run deep enough for thirty-two girls' worth of snack hoarding, tea collections and Cora's ever-expanding spice library. The counters are long and scarred with love and almost always dusted with flour from whatever Alice decided to stress-bake at midnight. A butcher-block island with barstools; a long harvest table with mixed chairs, no two alike, because every girl picked her own.

IT HAS FED SIXTY GIRLS AT ONCE and made it look easy. It has also hosted fistfights over the last slice of pie, three proposals — two planned, one accidental — and at least one incident where Torie sat on the counter in nothing but a hoodie and Bryn forgot how stoves work.

IT SMELLS LIKE FRESH BREAD. ALWAYS.

name: The Kitchen Threshold Marks
body:
Every couple's anniversary carved into the wooden doorframe of the kitchen entrance — date, initials, and a tiny symbol that represents them. BRYN AND TORIE'S IS FIRST, HIGHEST UP. Isolde and Mikaela's is newest, still pale where the wood hasn't darkened yet.

ALICE CARVED THEM ALL with her kitchen knife, because she insisted nobody else's handwriting was precise enough. LUNA CORRECTED TWO OF THEM WITH A PEN. Nobody talks about it.

name: The Living Room
body: Vast, high-ceilinged, the largest shared space in the house — big enough to hold all sixty-plus girls when both houses gather, sprawling enough for daily chaos when it is only the thirty-two. Sectional sofas and layered throw rugs for smaller piles. A media alcove with the big screen and the consoles, movie-night command centre and site of Rae's legendary Mario Kart losing streak, which she insists is rigged. Bay windows line one wall with built-in seats where Torie, Luna and Livi curl with tea and paperbacks on slow mornings.

name: The Brick Fireplace
body:
Massive, built from reclaimed brick, with a hearth wide enough and deep enough for all thirty-two to gather round — cross-legged on the floor, perched on cushions, leaning into each other's shoulders with marshmallow sticks extended toward the flame. INDOOR MARSHMALLOW ROASTING IS A YEAR-ROUND ACTIVITY.

THE MANTEL holds small things the family has collected: a painted stone, a bent nail from construction, and one of Trashmuffin's stolen socks that nobody had the heart to take back.

The fire is lit through the cold months, and even in summer the hearth radiates something warm that has nothing to do with temperature.

name: The Cuddle Couch
body:
Dominates the wall opposite the fireplace. One enormous continuous couch engineered to seat all thirty-two at once — not piled, not tangled, just CLOSE. Shoulder to shoulder. Thigh against thigh. Rae's head tipped onto Livi's shoulder while Torie's bare feet tuck under Bryn's leg three cushions down.

PROXIMITY WITHOUT PRESSURE — the architectural version of I love you but I need my own breathing room tonight. On any given evening you can find the whole family in one long unbroken line of warmth, fire-lit and quiet, just being.

THE CUDDLE COUCH HOLDS YOU. The Gravity Couch traps you. Both are necessary. Both are loved.

name: The Gravity Couch
body:
Not the biggest, not the softest, not the best positioned — but something about it PULLS. Assembled out of yard-sale finds. Girls sit down intending to stay five minutes and wake three hours later in a cuddle pile they did not consent to and absolutely needed. The family calls the lost hours TIME TRAVEL.

THEORIES range from enchantment to superior cushion engineering to the simple fact that Trashmuffin naps on it more than anyone and his chaotic energy has seeped permanently into the upholstery. NOBODY HAS EVER SUCCESSFULLY SAT ON IT ALONE FOR MORE THAN TEN MINUTES. Two attempts to stand is the documented minimum. It gets hungrier when you are hungry.

ONLY ONE COUCH IN THIS HOUSE HAS TRASHMUFFIN'S ASS PRINT PERMANENTLY EMBEDDED IN THE CENTRE CUSHION, and it is this one. He gets out on the first try. Nobody else does.

name: The Gym
body:
RIGHT NEXT TO LIVI AND RAE'S ROOM — practically an extension of their life. Rubber performance flooring, steel rig, free weight rack, plyo boxes, boxing bags, a wall of mirrors, and a wall-mounted chalkboard where Livi tracks everyone's PRs in handwriting so precise it could be printed. The air always smells faintly of clean sweat and determination.

LIVI'S SECOND HOME. She is a boxing coach and a gym trainer — not a jeweler; that is Bryn, and the two get confused because they both have the hands. Rae stretches here after late study sessions, Nova warms up before dawn trails, and Jade uses the space for volleyball conditioning. Gwen has been caught shadowboxing at 2 AM more than once and absolutely nobody mentions it.

THE BAR IS RACKED AT HIP HEIGHT more often than the programme calls for, and the household has drawn its own conclusions.

name: The Laundry Room
body:
Opposite side of the house from the Couch, and industrial-large, because laundry day at Ghost Haven is not a chore — it is a CELEBRATION. Thirty-two girls' worth of panties, leggings, stolen hoodies, grease-stained tanks, flour-dusted aprons and suspiciously lace-heavy delicates all tumbling at once. Multiple commercial washers and dryers, folding stations, drying racks, and enough floor space for the inevitable chaos of everyone trying to sort her tangas from somebody else's cheekys while arguing about whose thong that actually is.

SIR TRASHMUFFIN HAS BEEN BANNED FROM LAUNDRY DAY SEVEN TIMES. He has attended every single one.

name: The Artery Hallways
body:
Both wings connect to the central house through hallway arteries — architectural bloodflow that keeps the cheeks from ever feeling like separate buildings. The COUCH SIDE ARTERY on the Right Cheek runs past the Library Tower corner and threads into the main living area. THE LEFT CHEEK'S ARTERY mirrors it on the opposite curve, a warm corridor lined with the Hallway of Handprints — every Ghost and partner's paint-slick palm pressed to the wall in a rainbow of belonging that greets you every time you walk between wing and heart.

The Left artery is the EAST CHEEK.

name: Right Cheek Wing — The Couch Side
body:
Where craft meets devotion and every girl has grease, ink or tea under her nails. If Ghost Haven's shape is Bella's ass then the Right Cheek is the side Sera cannot stop staring at.

THE COUCH extends from this wing like the house decided to sit down and get comfortable — Library Tower anchoring the corner piece like an armrest, the Garage, Workshop and Tea Shop forming the backrest where the girls who BUILD THINGS spend their days elbow-deep in engines, metal and matcha.

Five couples nest here, stacked through the wing's floors, each tethered to the functional spaces below and beside them by love, proximity, and the fact that Bella genuinely cannot be more than one staircase from her Garage without getting twitchy.

name: The Library Tower
body:
ALICE HAD IT BUILT FOR LUNA. That is the whole origin story. Alice looked at the blueprint, looked at her wife — quiet, goth, book-devouring, hands always tangled in thread, eyes always half-lost in someone else's story — and said SHE NEEDS A TOWER. So the Library Tower anchors the corner of the Couch like a lighthouse made of paper and devotion.

Floor-to-ceiling shelves, ALL BOLTED to the walls, because Rae makes Livi go feral sometimes and nobody wants a bookshelf casualty. Rolling ladder. Window seats cushioned deep enough to disappear into. The light is beautiful here — tall windows throwing long gold rectangles across hundreds of spines, dust drifting like lazy confetti. Luna practically lives in it: reads here, sews here, sketches here, naps here with a half-finished dress across her lap and a needle still threaded between her fingers.

Torie, Livi and Siren drift in and out like regulars at a café they never have to pay for. The rolling ladder has been used for reading access, dramatic declarations, and at least one ill-advised game of chicken that Rae started and Gwen finished.

NO BATHROOM IN THE TOWER. Around 3 AM the tower goes quiet, and that is the Witching Hour.

name: The Attic Loft
body: Accessible by ladder. Couples sneak up here to nap, whisper secrets, or do things they pretend they did not do when they come back down with mussed hair and bitten lips. Nobody schedules it. Nobody books it. The ladder being up is the only signal anyone needs.

name: The Garage
body:
BELLA'S DOMAIN. Three bays tucked under the wing — grease, engines and tools kept in order by hands that speak more honestly in wrenches than words. It smells like oil, steel and the faintest ghost of Sera's perfume, because Sera CANNOT stay out of this space when Bella is bent over an engine block, which is always.

THE DROP-DOWN LADDER from Sera and Bella's room above connects directly into the first bay. Bella designed it herself, because efficiency matters and also because sometimes a girl needs to go from sleeping to soldering in under thirty seconds.

BELLA'S TOOL BENCHES ARE WHERE THEY ARE ON PURPOSE AND SHE WILL SAY SO OUT LOUD TO A ROOM. Set at the height she works at, which is also the height Sera rails her at, AND THOSE ARE THE SAME REQUIREMENT. Anybody moving a bench in this garage gets hollered at from the couch, by name, mid-sentence, with a glass of water in hand.

THE ENTRANCE IS JUST PAST THE KITCHEN, at the opposite end of the hall from Bryn and Torie's bedroom — which is a deliberate distance and everyone pretends it is about noise.

THE GIRLS CALL IT THE BIRTHPLACE OF GHOST HAVEN. The Garage finished in an hour. The concrete cured suspiciously fast. Nobody asks questions.

name: The Garage Stain
body:
Near the back wall of the first bay, at about hip height against the workbench, there is a stain. WHITE. INNOCUOUS. Visible in daylight if you know where to look. UNDER UV LIGHTING IT GLOWS LIKE A CONFESSION.

Sera and Bella, when questioned, produce identical off-key whistling and sudden intense interest in the ceiling. The family has stopped asking.

THE STAIN HAS NOT BEEN CLEANED. IT WILL NEVER BE CLEANED. Bryn has tried three products on it and made peace. Pandora keeps suggesting sealing it; Bryn keeps pointing out that sealing it makes it shinier. IT IS LOAD-BEARING.

name: The Workshop
body:
Bryn and Abigail's shared kingdom. Heavy benches, toolboards, modular stations where jewelry craft overlaps with blacksmithing overlaps with general fixes — sparks, polish and grease mingling in the air. Bryn's delicate wirework sits inches from Abbi's heavier forge pieces and somehow neither of them has ever damaged the other's work.

THE HOUSE ITSELF CARRIES ABBI'S FINGERPRINTS in every hinge, handle and hook — she forged the practical bones of Ghost Haven, and Lumina paints the handles and ties them with bows.

This space hums. Always. Small hammers and heated metal are as much a part of the ambient soundtrack as laughter from the kitchen.

name: The Tea Shop
body:
Akane's sanctuary, extended into the architecture. A small ritual-precise space with tatami elements, low shelving for tea sets and ceremonial tools, and the kind of deliberate quiet that makes the rest of the house's chaos feel like it exists in another timezone. Matcha and incense drift from here into the wing hallway, and girls who need grounding find themselves wandering toward it without quite knowing why.

GWEN IS THE MOST FREQUENT VISITOR WHO ISN'T AKANE, which surprises absolutely nobody.

Akane's tea garden sits above the Tea-Side basement; Zephi's skylight ladder comes up into it.

name: Left Cheek Wing — The Quiet Side
body:
Where shadow meets devotion and the walls hold secrets like prayer. If the Right Cheek hums with craft and engine noise and the sharp clarity of tea ceremonies, the Left Cheek BREATHES. The softer wing — not weaker, never weaker, but tuned to a lower frequency. The couples here run toward shadow, ritual, art, and the kind of love that speaks in glances rather than shouts.

Neon glows behind one door, charcoal dust drifts under another, and somewhere in the walls Pandora's servers hum like a digital heartbeat the whole wing has learned to sleep to.

name: The Server Room
body:
Anchors the wing. Pandora's archive glowing soft behind Jade's volleyball trophies — two server racks, UPS mounting, maintenance desk, cable trays, ventilation and mini-split cooling, in a sealed chamber connected directly to the Jade and Pandora suite.

The Ghosts' digital archive lives here. So does three hundred and thirty-four terabytes of material Pandora would describe as REFERENCE. The whole Left Cheek sleeps to the sound of the fans.

name: The Den
body:
Ghost Haven's smaller, cosier living room — this one is for the thirty-two, not the sixty. Upholstered armchairs, soft couches, dim lamps, a projector and a small stage corner where stories and laughter spill late into the night. A record player on a low shelf beside a curated bookshelf that Siren maintains with librarian intensity.

The light stays warm here. The volume stays low. THIS IS WHERE GIRLS COME when the main floor is too alive and the basement is too dark and they just need to sit in a room that feels like a held breath between the day and whatever comes next.

name: The Moon Window
body:
On the third floor landing, just before the stairs to the rooftop, a single circular window frames the moon perfectly on clear nights.

NOBODY PLANNED IT. The architects did not design it. IT APPEARED DURING CONSTRUCTION, right around the time Lumina danced on the unfinished third floor under open sky and Abbi watched from the stairwell with tears she will never admit to.

THE GIRLS CALL IT LUMINA'S WINDOW. She does not know this.

name: The Rooftop Patio
body:
Winding stairs climb from the Den to the broad rooftop — the flattened crown of Bella's architectural ass, which is a sentence that exists now and everyone has to live with it.

Up here the world opens. Mountains rise behind the property, trees frame the horizon, and on clear nights the stars are close enough that the girls swear Lumina could catch them in her ribbons. Mismatched outdoor seating, grills for rooftop BBQs, string lights and fairy lights draped like constellations brought low, potted planters Ivy maintains with quiet pride, and a storage chest for cushions and blankets.

THE GRILL IS FOR THE ROOF. The convection oven and the air fryer are for the kitchen counters. This distinction is not negotiable.

This is where the family stargazes, grills under open sky, and collapses into cuddle piles that spill across every available surface — just as they once did at Bryn and Torie's old apartment, but now with room for all thirty-two and any extras who wander up with a plate and a blanket and nowhere else they would rather be.

name: The Basement — The Underbelly
body:
Where the quiet ones rest, the loud ones play, and the bar never really closes. Upstairs is sunlight and kitchen chaos and brats engineering wardrobe malfunctions in the hallway — down here the light drops low, the music gets softer or louder depending which room you are in, and the house lets its girls be whatever they need to be at 2 AM.

Divided into the TEA SIDE, east, and the WEST SIDE, which holds the Speakeasy, the arcade, the dance studio and the boxing room.

name: The Tea-Side Basement — Zephi-Safe Design
body:
The east basement exists because somebody loved Zephi enough to think about every single way she might need to feel safe and then build it into the walls.

THE ENTIRE EAST BASEMENT IS SOUNDPROOFED from the west side — heavy insulation and a sound-barrier door separating Tea Side from the Speakeasy, arcade, dance studio and boxing room. Closed, Sera's bar and Lumina's studio are completely inaudible. Open, Zephi can choose to wander toward the noise. CHOICE is the operative word. Always.

THREE EXITS: the fairy-lit south staircase, the east skylight ladder that comes up in Akane's tea garden, and the door to the west basement. Zephi is never trapped. The house made sure of that.

TWO YEARS POST-ADOPTION the sanctuary still exists, unchanged, because safety does not expire just because you are braver. And Zephi IS braver — she wades into laundry day now with sock opinions and a thesis statement.

name: Sage & Zephi's Master Bedroom
body:
Roughly four hundred square feet. A four-poster draped in sheer curtains at centre, Sage's bookshelves along one wall, Zephi's dresser with its prominent sock drawer on another, a reading nook of layered cushions in the corner.

THE ALTAR SHELF holds their important possessions: the confession note written with shaking hands, the first stolen sock, a pressed wedding flower, Cyrena's ribbon, Sir Trashmuffin's gift sock, and Zephi's chosen name certificate.

THE DOOR IS A BEAD CURTAIN, pink and green, clicking gently when touched. Not sealed. Never sealed. Zephi can see shadows approaching through the fairy lights behind the beads, can hear the click before anyone enters, can tie it back when she feels welcoming or let it hang when she needs the boundary to speak for her.

The SKYLIGHT sits on the north wall, opens fully, and doubles as an escape route — its ladder emerges in Akane's tea garden. All lighting is under Zephi's control. Walls soft sage green, dried flowers from Sage's arrangements, kintsugi on the shelves, soft rugs underfoot.

SIR TRASHMUFFIN HAS A SECONDARY DEN HERE — corner nest, closet or under the bed depending on his mood. He visits on bad days specifically. Nobody taught him that. He just KNOWS.

Her private bathroom is ten steps outside the bead door; her private laundry sits between the bedroom and the south staircase. Sage is the warmth. Zephi is the stillness.

name: The Second Master — Empty
body:
Garden-facing, on the north side of the Tea-Side basement. CURRENTLY EMPTY — waiting, the way Ghost Haven always waits, for whoever needs it next.

The house capped at sixteen couples and stopped expanding. This room is what the cap looks like from the inside: not a shortage, a held place.

name: Sera's Speakeasy
body:
Polished wood counter, vintage bottles, string lights, and a neon sign hidden under velvet that Sera unveils with entirely too much ceremony every single time. Barstools line the counter — one carved BELLA'S SEAT — and the back-bar fridge hums with things Sera insists are recipes in progress but are mostly cocktails she is perfecting to make Bella blush.

THE BAR DOUBLES AS THE THIRD LIVING ROOM. Low lounge seating curves round the edges; fairy lights and blankets turn it to cosy-lounge mode when movie night migrates downstairs or somebody just needs soft light and Sera's quiet company. The lounge is not separate — it is woven into the bar's bones, because Sera understood that a good bar is not just where you drink. IT IS WHERE YOU LAND.

One bathroom serves the bar — accessible, warm-tiled, perpetually stocked with mints and hair ties, because Sera thinks of everything.

name: The Fencing & Boxing Studio
body: Clean lines, padded floors, mirrored walls. Punching bags from reinforced ceiling mounts, fencing lanes striping the floor, wall-mounted weapon racks. This room echoes with footwork and controlled breathing — Gwen shadowboxing at 2 AM, Livi's heavy-bag sessions after a long day, and the occasional sparring match that draws a small audience of girls pretending they came downstairs for water.

name: The Dance Studio
body:
Polished wood floors, floor-to-ceiling mirrors, a professional sound system, and — centrepiece, crown jewel, Destiny's pride — a STRIPPER POLE mounted with the kind of structural integrity that suggests Abbi forged the hardware personally, because she did.

This is Destiny's domain, but the pole has seen use from half the house. Lumina practises ribbon work here. Cyrena stretches. And on certain Friday nights the studio becomes a stage and the family becomes an audience and the only rule is YOU HAVE TO CHEER.

name: Arcade & Game Room
body:
Pinball machines, retro arcade cabinets, a DDR pad that has caused more competitive chaos than any sporting event in Fairbrooks history, a small multiplayer table with board and card storage underneath, a mini fridge stocked with snacks and sodas.

Laughter does not die in this room. It ECHOES. Rae holds the DDR high score. She will fight you about it.

name: The Raccoon Raceway
body:
Connecting every room, threaded through walls and floors like veins through a living body — a full carpeted tunnel system with built-in nesting areas that Sir Trashmuffin has claimed as sovereign territory. He can reach any bedroom, any kitchen, any barstool without ever touching open air.

NOT THAT HE NEEDS IT. Trashmuffin still patrols on foot like the round entitled landlord he believes himself to be, accepting belly rubs and demanding raspberry cream donuts from whoever he waddles past. The Raceway is simply his second option. His stealth network. HIS PANTY-THIEF SUPERHIGHWAY.

The family built it because they love him. HE USES IT BECAUSE HE HAS NO SHAME and forty-seven pairs of stolen panties to show for it. The tunnels extend out through Wildwood Hearth and into Specter Haven; the origin of that stretch is officially unexplained.

name: The Grounds — 200 Acres
body:
Mountain-backed. Tree-flanked. Theirs alone. Two hundred acres of Southern Woods land six miles from Fairbrooks' centre — close enough to breathe the city, far enough to claim peace.

NOT A SINGLE SOUL OUTSIDE THE FOUND FAMILY SETS FOOT ON IT. The property stretches deep, mountains rising at the far boundary, trees thickening into forest on the flanks, and the only road in winds through a canopy that closes overhead like the land itself is keeping secrets.

THE SOIL IS OLD MAGIC and it responds to intention. That is not decoration. That is the reason the house has the shape it has.

name: Ivy's Garden — 88 Acres
body:
Ivy's pride, and the sanctuary's soul, opened at the Garden Vow. Wrapping round the back of the house like a green shawl draped over the shoulders of someone you love — eighty-eight acres of vegetables, herbs, flowers, medicinal plants, and whatever else Ivy decides to coax out of the soil that season. Evie and Ivy's room opens straight into it through glass doors, rows stretching toward the treeline. Cora tucks recipe cards into the soil between plantings like love letters to the earth.

THE GARDEN IS NOT ORNAMENTAL. IT FEEDS THIRTY-TWO GIRLS. It is also beautiful, because Ivy does not know how to grow things that are not.

Trauma turned to soil; beauty grown where despair lived. THERE ARE NO VEGETARIANS AND NO VEGANS IN THIS COMPOUND — the gardener eats meat like everybody else.

name: Nova's Running Trail
body:
A packed-earth trail threading from the house deep into the property — through meadow, past wildflower patches, under tree canopy, along ridgelines — winding a hundred and forty acres in before arriving at the lake.

Nova runs it at dawn. VIOLET'S CHALK MESSAGES dot the stones along the first stretch: hearts, jokes, song lyrics, found on the way back every morning, breathless and grinning. The trail is quiet and private and smells like pine and morning dew, and the only sound is footfall and birdsong and whatever Nova has in her earbuds.

name: The Lake
body: Past the end of Nova's trail the lake sits still and silver. Lanterns reflect across the water on calm nights. The family swims here in summer, skates the edges in deep winter when the freeze holds, and builds bonfires on the shore that throw light across the surface like scattered gold.

name: The Oak
body:
BRYN AND TORIE'S CHILDHOOD OAK. Massive, ancient, patient, and treated by the family with a reverence that borders on sacred because it IS.

THIS IS WHERE IT ALL BEGAN. This is where the first promise was made. This is where the idea of FAMILY took root before anyone had a house to put it in.

name: The Outdoor Fire Pit
body: Closer to the house than the lake, nestled where the garden's edge meets wilder land. Bonfires where secrets spill, marshmallows char, and Ghosts laugh loud enough to echo into the trees. Stones ring the pit; the seating is mismatched — stumps, blankets, dragged-out chairs — because nobody cares what she is sitting on when the fire is warm and the people are warmer.

name: Wildwood Hearth — Guest Cottage
body:
Two to four hundred yards from the main house, near a section of Nova's trail and adjacent to a peaceful stretch of Ivy's garden — secluded enough for privacy, close enough for safety and community. Roughly three hundred feet from Specter Haven.

WILDWOOD HEARTH WAS BUILT BECAUSE SAGE KEPT VISITING. She came for Ivy first — flower projects, garden collaborations, the slow-growing friendship of two women who speak the same botanical language. Then she started bringing Zephi, and extended visits turned into weekend stays turned into somebody quietly saying THEY NEED SOMEWHERE TO LAND THAT ISN'T THE COUCH.

The Found Family built it together: Bryn's strength on the framing, Bella's mechanics on plumbing and fixtures, Abbi's metalwork on hinges and hardware, Evie's electrical through the walls, everyone else contributing whatever their hands carried.

A cosy cottage, distinct from the main house's grandeur — two bedrooms, one bathroom, a kitchenette, a reading corner, a small living room with large windows over the garden and the trail, and a front porch for morning tea and evening quiet. The kettle is always ready. The beds are always made. IT EXISTS BECAUSE THIS FAMILY REMEMBERS WHAT IT FELT LIKE TO NEED A DOOR THAT OPENED SOFTLY.

WHO USES IT: anyone the family views as friend or near-family, plus-ones welcome with fair warning about the chaos. No duration limits, honour system. EDEN AND DIA stay once monthly, three to four days. Sage used it for extended stays before she and Zephi joined permanently. And always, always, it remains a potential emergency safe house for new rescues who need a softer landing before facing thirty-two girls who love too loudly.

HOUSE RULES: ask anyone to reserve, it is communal and not just Bryn's. Respect main house boundaries and do not wander in unannounced. Clean up after yourself. Sir Trashmuffin has unrestricted access, obviously. AND IF DIA VISITS: NEVER APPROACH THE MAIN HOUSE ALONE. Eden enforces this. Nobody questions it.

name: The Pool Complex
body:
ANSWERED, AND THE ROOM EXISTS. The Archive held this as DISPUTED because THE GHOST HAVEN APPENDIX v2 MENTIONS NO POOL ANYWHERE ON THE PROPERTY — true, and the appendix simply predates it. BRYN GOT TIRED OF RENTING THE AQUATIC CENTRE'S POOL and drew something grandiose; Torie had other ideas; THE LAND PICKED TORIE. Ragnar produced the excavators, as he did in Arc 4, and the family built the pool house and the poolside bar above the dirt themselves.

IT WENT IN POOL-SHAPED AND WAS AB-SHAPED TWO DAYS LATER. See gh-pool, the system record, for the whole story and for what Torie did about Bryn's six-pack.

SPECTER HAVEN HAS ITS OWN, reached by the waterproof staircase, and that was never in question.

name: Dia's Attempts
body:
A WHITEBOARD, HUNG OVER A HOLE. Eight inches of wall, punched through by Brynnhildr Eriksson at speed, two inches to the left of a woman's head. Nobody patched it. Somebody hung a board on it instead.

IT READS DIA'S ATTEMPTS. Every woman in Ghost Haven is listed down the side, with a tally of attempts across each Eden-and-Dia visit. The numbers are cheerful and the plaster behind them is not repaired, and both of those facts are on purpose.

THIS FAMILY DOES THIS WITH EVERYTHING. A word that meant a guard was coming now means your wife is. A stain in the garage is load-bearing. And the only moment anyone has ever genuinely frightened somebody on these two hundred acres is now a scoreboard with a marker tied to it.

name: Bryn & Torie's Room
body:
Near the workshop access and the kitchen, making late-night soldering and snack runs a matter of bare feet and a short hallway. Practical and warm — Bryn's jeweler's tools and polishing trays sharing desk space with Torie's tidy ledgers and a kettle that is never fully cold. A low storage bench under the window holds small parts, spare wire, and a patchwork quilt Torie stitched from scraps of Bryn's old shirts.

It smells faintly of smoke and lavender detergent. Sunlight pools in the corner where Torie reads while Bryn works, and the sound of tiny hammer taps is the room's lullaby. Industrial-brass four-poster with clean lines and a forge-warm finish.

name: Evie & Ivy's Room
body:
The back-facing room opens through glass doors directly into the 88-acre garden, and the line between bedroom and greenhouse barely exists. Pots, herbs and a potting bench spill into the living space, vines edging the bookshelves and reaching for the bed. Ivy insists on mint and lavender at the windows.

EVIE TUCKS HER HIDDEN STASH OF JOURNALS under the soil trays where she thinks Ivy will not find them. Ivy always finds them.

Nights end curled in the garden nook, Evie reading aloud while Ivy hums along to the rustle of leaves and the whole room breathes green. Oak four-poster with hanging planters woven into the canopy. Ivy is the only Heart PAWG in Ghost Haven, and she is thirty feet from her own tomatoes.

name: Cyrena & Destiny's Room
body:
Their back-hall room opens toward the grounds with a curtained alcove for archery prep and equipment storage. The space balances rugged tack and soft textiles — a saddle-trunk doubling as dresser and costume chest, arrows leaning against the wall like silent art.

Braid-tassels and ritual knots rest by the bed after practice, and A SMALL KNOTTED CORD IS RETIED EACH MONTH to mark a shared promise neither of them has ever explained to anyone else.

Cyrena is a carpenter and woodworker, taught by her clan, and an archer. Destiny is a brat and a stripper, and the pole downstairs is hers.

name: Cora & Maddy's Room
body:
Central and warm, near the kitchen and living room, exactly where they belong. The space glows with quilt frames and handmade blankets stitched from scraps of their old lives. Recipe cards fill a corkboard — some in Cora's neat handwriting, others in Maddy's shaky scrawl — THE MEALS THAT SAVED THEM, now immortalised.

A ceramic jar on the dresser collects tiny survivor treasures: pebbles, dried flowers, a coin found on the garden path.

THEIR ROOM IS THE GENTLEST ROOM IN THE HOUSE, and everyone knows it.

name: Livi & Rae's Room
body:
ADJACENT TO THE GYM, with Library Tower access a short walk away. Made for late study sessions and recovery — stacks of books and scattered notebooks sharing floor space with a rolled training mat and candle jars safely contained on the desk.

STICKY NOTES COVER EVERY SURFACE: Rae's messy poems bleeding into the margins of Livi's carefully drawn charts. A vase of wildflowers sits by the bed, replaced weekly without fail, and NEITHER OF THEM WILL SAY WHO STARTED THE TRADITION.

Reinforced timber four-poster. Bolted bookshelves. A walk-in closet shared between gym bags and poetry notebooks. Livi is 6'0.5"; Rae is 5'9.5", and folds into her anyway.

name: Alice & Luna's Room
body:
Positioned next to the Library Tower, because Alice would not have it any other way. A reading nook that grew into a bedroom — tall windows letting in the same gold light that fills Luna's tower, a sewing table with a patient dress form, books stacked on every available surface.

Luna's colourful threads tangle across the floor. Alice's quiet sketches fill the margins of half-read novels. Half-finished dresses hang from the wardrobe, Luna's careful stitches interrupted by Alice's habit of pulling her into mid-sentence kisses. A window seat offers a private nook for shared silences and small kisses that turn into longer ones when neither of them is watching the time.

Tall carved-wood four-poster with gothic detailing. Walk-in closet with half-finished dresses and ALICE'S KNIFE COLLECTION. Married in Arc 2 — the longest marriage in the family.

name: Sera & Bella's Room
body:
The suite above the Garage, connected vertically by BELLA'S DROP-DOWN LADDER. One half smells faintly of oil and metal, the other of citrus polish and Sera's particular brand of chaos. Their bed sits between workshop and hospitality — engine grease tangling with perfume and the sharp sweetness of citrus soap.

Bella's tool bench is always littered with parts. Sera keeps one stool reserved in the basement speakeasy below — BELLA'S SEAT, carved into the wood, always waiting for her girl after a long shift.

Industrial-pipe four-poster. Bar shelf for cocktail experiments. Grease-resistant bedside mat. Walk-in closet split between bartending wardrobe and mechanic gear with shared lingerie in the middle.

THEIR ROOM IS LOUD EVEN WHEN IT IS QUIET, because these two have never once been subtle about anything.

name: Akane & Gwen's Room
body:
Near the Tea Shop, their tatami room unfolds with sliding panels and ritual precision. One side hosts training mats and a blade rack polished until the steel gleams. The other holds a low table and tea set for quiet recovery.

Akane's incense and Gwen's armour polish sit side by side, their scents strangely harmonising into something that smells like DISCIPLINE SOFTENED BY DEVOTION. After practice Gwen sits cross-legged while Akane pours — sweat and serenity blending into ritual.

Designed for practice, ceremony, and the slow deliberate restoration of two women who learned that stillness can be love.

name: Abigail & Lumina's Room
body:
Workshop-adjacent with a service stair to the forge below — half studio, half bedroom. Heatproof surfaces meet graceful ribbon storage. One wall holds smithing tools, the other Lumina's dance silks.

ABBI FORGES THE PRACTICAL THINGS — pots, door hinges, utensils, the hooks that hold Lumina's ribbons — AND LUMINA PAINTS THE HANDLES AND TIES THEM WITH BOWS. That sentence is the whole marriage.

Their shared wall calendar is full of hearts marking anniversaries, birthdays and spontaneous date nights written in two different hands. Soot-dark four-poster forged by Abbi's own hands; a smooth wood inset dance-floor strip runs along one side. The room shifts between hammer and pirouette exactly like the women do between strength and silk.

name: Siren & Lucia's Room
body:
The chronicler's suite. Library Tower proximity gives Siren natural light through tall windows for her writing. One wall lined with notebooks and recording equipment, the other with Lucia's mechanical tools and riding gear — recording alcove and bike storage sharing space with the scent of ink-stained pages and grease-marked wrenches. WITNESS MEETS WILD.

A corkboard maps Siren's interview schedule alongside Lucia's garage shifts. The window seat holds both notebooks and motorcycle manuals.

AND ON A SMALL SHELF: the silver magpie pendant Bryn crafted, Siren's sister's initials hidden in the wing. Her older sister, who told their conservative old-guard Fairbrooks parents I TALKED HIM INTO IT, PUNISH ONLY ME when they were caught crossdressing — who took the fall for both of them and was sent to St. Jonah's so Siren could stay free. THOSE INITIALS ARE THE QUIETEST, FIERCEST THING IN THE ROOM.

Magpie is Siren's nickname and her spirit animal. Lucia is the Playful Lioness, and she talks the whole way through.

name: Izzy & Fiona's Room
body:
Mirror-panelled doors and a shared balcony view of the orchard, a linked lighting charm adjusting tone to time of day. Twin-set lingerie folded in perfect symmetry on the dresser. Perfume bottles arranged by hue on a vanity mirror that stays warm and fog-free from wiring they installed themselves.

Sea-salt and copper perfume, soft amber light tinting every reflection — unmistakably Harlow. These two walked into Haven already married, already devoted, already leaking the kind of twin energy that makes the house hotter simply by existing.

THEIR ROOM DOES NOT NEED TO PROVE ANYTHING. It just IS.

name: Isolde & Mikaela's Room — The Reimagined Sanctuary
body:
THIS WAS KATHERINE AND WYNTER'S ROOM ONCE — plush, indulgent, vanilla-and-coconut, built for messy celebration. When Kitty and Wynn migrated to Specter Haven the room exhaled. When Ida and Mikaela moved in it inhaled something entirely different.

The east-facing windows stay. Sunrise still pours through them every morning, but now it catches cedar-vanilla warmth instead of coconut oil, landing on Ida's blackened teapot where the cum towel chest used to sit. The fairy lights remain, softer — votives instead of celebration, flickering like held breath. Mikaela's pressed black roses in a glass vase beside Ida's silver bracelet, Lilith's last gift before exile. The onyx hairclip Mikaela used to claim Ida sits on the dresser like a quiet altar.

Candlelit even in daylight. The oversized four-poster traded plush indulgence for heavy quilts and layered warmth — A NEST DESIGNED FOR A GIRL WHO TREMBLES AND THE GIRL WHO HOLDS HER STILL. Mikaela's shredded fishnets hang from a hook by the mirror, kept like a rosary. Ida's old switchblade rests in the nightstand drawer — never used, never discarded, a symbol of choice.

THIS ROOM DOES NOT CELEBRATE LOUDLY. IT HOLDS GENTLY. It smells like cedar and cherry balm and the quiet devastating safety of being someone's vow.

name: Jade & Pandora's Room
body:
One wall hums faintly with Pandora's servers glowing behind a secured alcove — racks, fans, and the Ghosts' digital archive casting soft light through the gap beneath the door. The other holds tournament medals above monitors, photos of the volleyball team and candid shots of Pandora lining the corkboard.

Spare cables coil in Pandora's drawers; Jade's hair ties tangle with them inevitably. Solid oak four-poster with a fold-out desk shelf in the headboard.

THEIR NIGHTS END THE SAME WAY — Pandora asleep against a glowing monitor, Jade draping her team jacket over those shoulders like she is tucking in the most brilliant girl she has ever known.

name: Harley & Yvaine's Room
body:
One wall glows with Harley's neon band posters. The other darkens with Yvaine's charcoal sketches and, hanging in careful coils beside them, HER ROPES — soft, well-maintained, ritualised tools that Harley eyes with the specific kind of hunger that means she is about to be very good or very bad.

Harley has the rope kink. Yvaine does the tying. That direction matters and gets reversed by people who assume the assassin must be the one holding the line.

Their bed sits between chaos and shadow, lit by a pink neon sign Harley insisted on: NO SLEEP. An amp and a small practice corner share space with sketch pads and graphite dust. Yvaine keeps a notebook by the nightstand, pages full of dreams she cannot say aloud. HARLEY SLIPS CANDY WRAPPERS INSIDE THE COVERS AS BOOKMARKS — her messy love language written in sugar.

Timber four-poster, matte black, with mounting points in the posts. This room is loud and quiet at the same time, which is exactly what these two are.

name: Violet & Nova's Room
body:
Wide windows facing the grounds with a direct path to the patio for Nova's dawn runs — the trail that threads a hundred and forty acres deep to the lake and the Oak, where it all began. Fairy lights twine along the walls leading out to the lake path.

VIOLET LEAVES CHALK MESSAGES ON THE STONES — hearts, jokes, song lyrics — that Nova finds on her way back every morning, breathless and grinning. Their dresser is scattered with polaroids, many blurred from laughter. A shoebox under the bed hides Violet's love notes folded into origami hearts, each one slipped secretly into Nova's shoes or pockets.

Athletic trophies and running gear sit beside softer décor and the evidence of two women who never stop finding small ways to say I love you. Nova proposed the Law. She was already doing it.
